scope: Official source status and stated interface contracts; no vendor efficacy replication or new implementation qualification.
artifact_policy: No package, model, binary, image or repository downloaded or installed. Existing locked graph tools reused. URLs identify consulted pages, not immutable content digests.

sources.finding: Vendor describes typed decisions and probabilities trained for calibration; observed group rates are not a guarantee for an individual answer.
sources.limit: Does not supply an independently reproduced Jev training method or HSWM transfer result.

sources.sections: Question types, same state, answer fields and independent questions
sources.finding: Choice, Score and Noul typed questions read the same state; the documented per-question independence is not a proof of statistical independence of world variables.
sources.limit: No API call, SDK adoption, checkpoint certification or joint-output benchmark performed.

sources.sections: Status; Entity, Activity and derivation vocabulary
sources.finding: Provenance representation; the existing HSWM adapter implements a bounded view-derivation envelope, not generic runtime learning provenance.
Structural constraints are evaluated against a shapes graph; conformance is not factual truth or scientific efficacy.

sources.sections: Status; Pattern 1 introducing a class for a relation; ordered arguments
sources.finding: Relation instances and participant roles can express n-ary structure using RDF binary properties; HSWM version/owner/slot preservation remains an application contract.
